findings.source: memory.hpp; memory.cpp constructor and Impl allocation ledger
findings.observation: Requires sole-owned clean ApplicationMemory plus owning LifecycleEffects; failed validation does not consume the rvalue-reference provider. Own backing lease retains real DomainStorage. Per-ticket list metadata and region vector capacity are reserved before backing allocation. Actual typed control sizeof is allocated separately from native1c8 free routing; proxy16, block32 and map/raw extents are individually tracked. This implements source composition, not recovered04b0bc/04b0f8 or native class ABI.

findings.topic: Typed/raw lifetime, bounded registry and known retry
findings.observation: Control/block regions expose only their inline16; map and byte regions cover their own raw storage including large aligned header, avoiding overlapping registrations. Pointer arrays have explicit placement lifetimes. End typed lifetimes exactly once, then retain Retired raw record on a failed free. Retry requires quiescent backing AllocationState::Live; Unknown/Busy/Missing or query failure cannot authorize physical free. A successful physical free followed by PTD/commit failure poisons and is never retried. No failed recovered algorithm is automatically resumed.

Owned list records contain the actual ConstructionScratch. A source throw after a control is returned retains real temporary/service-list storage and partial allocation. Pre-control allocation failure removes unused scratch only. No stack temporary is left referenced by a service list, no speculative native EH rollback or automatic retry is introduced.

findings.source: memory.cpp Impl::Access/require_ptd; Operation; memory_tests.cpp nine own children
findings.observation: Recursive whole-call lock serializes registry/source-chain use; Operation rejects nested operation and captures real thread/fiber/native-FLS slot/PTD identity. API entry, pre/post backing effects and scope exit recheck; mismatch poisons without restoring PTD. Final require_ptd first rejects phase!=Open, so nested callbacks cannot catch a violation, restore FLS and make outer typed publication or post-free commit succeed. Final --ptd-restore and --ptd-restore-free regressions cover this corrected review blocker. Entry/post/exit PTD failures, partial constructor and unknown allocation/free outcomes are retained in nine own child processes, reclaimed only by OS process exit.

findings.source: memory.cpp close and destructor; memory_tests.cpp provider_retirement
findings.observation: Close refuses active, partial, allocated or poisoned state without disabling valid future allocation. Once empty, sets Retiring before moving providers; lifecycle and backing refs retire outside the domain gate. Reentrant entry rejects, nested close returns false until complete, then phase becomes Closed. Destructor requires successful Closed even if originally empty. Service/context ownership and external async stop/drain remain provider/caller contracts.

Existing ApplicationMemory allocation/free implementations and layout are unchanged.
